program_name: PacifiCan Business Scale-Up and Productivity Program
amount_notes: Up to 50% of eligible project costs maximum $5M. Interest-free loan. Repayment within 6 years of project completion with 1-year grace period then 60 equal monthly payments. Reimbursement model — costs must be incurred and paid before claiming.
organization_types_eligible: High-growth for-profit businesses incorporated in Canada
BC businesses operating in Canada for at least 2 years
Businesses with staffed operating facilities in BC
eligibility_criteria: Must be incorporated in Canada and operating in BC for at least 2 years
Must be a high-growth for-profit business
Must be scaling up and producing innovative goods, services, or technologies
Must have staffed operating facilities in BC
Must demonstrate confirmed funding from all other sources
At least 50% of proposed project costs from non-government sources
exclusions: CRITICAL: Repayable loan not a grant — full principal repayment required within 6 years
Basic and applied R&D at Technology Readiness Level 1-6 not eligible
SR&ED credits received for same activities reduce PacifiCan funding — must disclose
BC operations required — national or Alberta-based companies not eligible
notes: REPAYABLE LOAN — will appear in FINANCING section only. Sacral Solutions deck lists this as a grant under Tier 2 funding strategy — this is inaccurate. PacifiCan BSP is a no-interest repayable contribution not a non-repayable grant. Previous intake closed April 2025 — verify current intake status before applying. SR&ED and PacifiCan interact: if claiming SR&ED credits on same activities, PacifiCan may reduce funding to keep total government assistance under 50% of project costs. Medical device commercialization and market scale-up are eligible activities. HealthTech Connex received $3.7M through this program for medical device commercialization — strong precedent for Sacral.
